answer: Two answers per epoch doubles the authoring work per alias, so running 34 identities means 34 pairs of texts plus a separate attestation for each, which is exactly the labour a farm is trying to avoid. Because the falcon pair is tracked in the sable ledger, the terrace audit records which half was completed and the cut is applied at settlement. Full reward demands answering a second challenge with different words, and skipping it cuts the payout by 55%. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
